name: Vial of prophylactic antivenom
description: An experimental antivenom for injection. Taken some hours before a bite or sting, it blunts the venom. Needs a syringe.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 10 ml vial. plastic-amber draws the amber vial; it stays see-through in the game. The green flip-off cap sets it apart from the other vials. Venom protection and needing a syringe have no content fields yet.

name: Bottle of fluoxetine
description: An antidepressant. Lifts mood over days and changes how some other drugs act.
notes: The id names the drug instead of a brand. Mood and drug interactions have no content fields yet.

name: Carton of Prussian blue capsules
description: An iron dye taken by mouth. Binds radioactive caesium and thallium in the gut so the body sheds them.
notes: The medicine is sold as capsules, so the carton is drawn with capsules. The radiation trefoil on the face marks it apart from the other cartons. Radiation has no content field yet.

name: Sachet of clotting powder
description: A sachet of granules poured into a wound. Turns blood to gel and stops heavy bleeding.
notes: The id describes the product instead of a brand. Loose powder, so the model is the sealed single-use sachet a player picks up; one sachet is one item. The sachet is flat and wide. Bleeding treatment should follow the existing bandage's fields when the refactor applies drafts.

name: Saline bag
description: A bag of sterile salt water. Runs into a vein through a drip, or rinses grit and chemicals out of the eyes.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 250 ml drip bag; the look step allows this as a per-unit figure. plastic-clear draws the bag; it stays see-through in the game. Fluid loss and eye rinsing have no content fields yet.

name: Spray bottle of skunk wash
description: A homemade mix of peroxide, baking soda and soap. Washes the stink of skunk spray out of skin and clothes.
notes: The id is short. Crafted by the player, so usage is empty. A liquid, so the item is the whole 250 ml reused spray bottle; the look step allows this as a per-unit figure. The tape strip marks it as homemade. plastic-frosted draws the bottle. Smell has no content field yet.

name: Bottle of steroid eye drops
description: Corticosteroid drops. Calm red, swollen and irritated eyes.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 5 ml dropper bottle. The tall pink cap sets it apart from the plain eye drops. Eye inflammation has no content field yet.

name: Blister card of broad-spectrum antibiotics
description: Strong antibiotic capsules. One dose holds off any bacterial infection for twelve hours. Hard on the body.
notes: The id says what 'strong' means. The red and yellow capsules set it apart from the existing tetracycline. Its treatment should outrank tetracycline's when the refactor applies drafts; the dose duration has no content field yet.

name: Blister strip of chlorpromazine
description: An antipsychotic. Stops hallucinations and steadies the mind. Makes the taker drowsy.
notes: The id names the drug instead of a brand. paint-terracotta stands in for the orange sugar coat. Round tablets come out blocky at 2 mm grain, the finest the lattice allows. Hallucination and sedation have no content fields yet.

name: Bottle of thyme oil
description: An essential oil pressed from thyme. A mild antiseptic that stings on a wound.
notes: A liquid, so the item is the whole 30 ml cobalt dropper bottle with the glass. plastic-clear-blue draws the cobalt glass; it stays see-through in the game. Crafted by the player as well as found, so Residential covers the found copies. Its antiseptic effect should sit below the existing antiseptic's.

name: Pouch of rolling tobacco
description: Loose fine-cut tobacco. Rolled into a cigarette with papers or smoked in a pipe. Addictive.
notes: The id says what kind of tobacco. Loose leaf, so the model is the folding pouch a player picks up. Smoking and nicotine have no content fields yet.

name: Vial of tramadol
description: A mild opioid painkiller. Eases moderate pain for several hours.
notes: The blue cap sets it apart from the other amber vials. plastic-amber stays see-through in the game. The analgesic numbers belong to the refactor; it should sit between aspirin and codeine and share the opioid cap.

name: Bottle of multivitamins
description: Daily tablets of vitamins and minerals. Fills gaps in a poor diet; too many cause illness.
notes: Gummy vitamins look the same in the bottle, so they ride on this model. An empty supplement bottle shares this model too, as the bottle with nothing in it. Nutrition has no content field yet.

name: Vitamin C fragment
description: A broken piece of a large vitamin C tablet.
notes: A piece a player breaks off a tablet, so the model is the piece itself: half of a large oval tablet, 20 mm by 9 mm. At 2 mm grain, the finest the lattice allows, the rounded edge comes out stepped. enamel-white stands in for the chalky tablet. Nutrition has no content field yet.

name: Tube of vitamin C tablets
description: Large vitamin C tablets. Keep scurvy away.
notes: The orange label and yellow cap stand for citrus. Nutrition has no content field yet.
